fields.summary: Two rough edges the orchestrator hit on 2026-11-01. During a daemon re-exec, rhiza daemon status printed only the process, with empty start and poll times, max runs 0 and no live runs, for several seconds: the new image takes the lock with a new start time, so status finds the state file names the old image and shows only the process, and the new image writes no state until its first poll ends (planning and notify take seconds), although the State comment says the file is written at start. And the main checkout kept a change set that landed on Oct 28 as its current one, because land clears the current change set only in the checkout that runs it, and work lands from run worktrees; writes and the model already treat a terminal current change set as none, but rhiza status and the session hook show it with no next step.
fields.title: Milestone 21: status tells the truth
